messages:
alex: Quick q — we just merged a config-only change (redis timeout tweak) into main. Should we bump patch or minor for the release tag? planning to cut release today.

maria: patch imo. semver: patch = backwards-compatible bugfixes, config only is patch

simon: +1 patch. but watch for behavior changes that might affect clients (feature flags?)

olivia: Sidenote: do we have a tagging convention? Some repos use vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, others drop the leading 'v'. We should be consistent across mono-repo.

release-bot: auto:deploy queued for tag v1.4.3 -> staging (requested by @alex)

alex: Proposed tag: v1.4.3 with release note: "chore(config): reduce redis dial timeout; no user-facing changes". Anyone object?

maria: LGTM. Also suggest adding [release-type: patch] to changelog header so downstream infra picks it up.

simon: Can we / should we ever use minor for non-breaking ops config? E.g., changing default batch sizes that could affect throughput? That feels like minor because it can change observable behavior.

olivia: Policy proposal: minor bump only for new public APIs or changes that alter observable behavior for external clients. Anything else: patch. Let's add to RELEASES.md.

alex: Agree. I'll update RELEASES.md and push tag.

alex: Command I'll run:

```bash
git tag -a v1.4.3 -m "chore(config): redis timeout tweak"
git push origin v1.4.3
```

deploy-bot: started rollout for v1.4.3 to staging at 2025-08-10T14:05:22Z

maria: FYI for Dedicated customers we also include a 'platform' label: release/platform=v1.4.3 in the k8s manifest. Keep that consistent.

alex: Noted. Decision: patch bump, tag format 'vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH', changelog entry includes '[release-type: patch]'. I'll PR RELEASES.md after cut.

simon: One more: let's standardize commit prefixes: fix:, feat:, chore:, perf:. Then an automated release job can infer semver if needed.

olivia: +1. Could be optional but useful for automation.

alex: OK rolling. Will report back on staging tests. :rocket: 

deploy-bot: rollout to staging succeeded for v1.4.3 (3/3 pods ready)

alex: staging looks green. Proceeding to prod canary.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for v1.4.3 -> prod-canary

maria: no anomalies in logs. :thumbsup:

olivia: good. tagging convention and RELEASES.md PR incoming.

alex: thanks everyone.
